description: super-reprompt: H1 suggests framing a large request (one line, never blocks), H2 re-injects a short mission reminder after compaction or resume, H3 gates the end of an executing mission. All three go through hooks/run.sh (real Python 3 only, Store stubs skipped, path cached) and fail open and stay silent unless relevant. Set SUPER_REPROMPT_HOOKS=0 to turn them off. L4: the PreToolUse firewall (guard.py) is silent unless a mission has been sealed (SCELLE.json); inside a sealed mission it fails CLOSED (exit 2).
